g.text: START HERE: the whole project in 1 picture, 3 rules, 6 files, 7 exercises
Ignore everything else at first. If you can explain this page, you can explain the project in an interview. Full guide: docs/start-here.md
A. The whole project in one picture
file: a PR titled feat: / fix:
B. The 3 rules (say these in the interview)
1 Deploy = change a file in Git
no kubectl apply, no helm upgrade
Actions only tests, builds, edits Git
ArgoCD pulls from inside the cluster
3 Build once, promote the same image
the dev image goes to qa and prod
C. The only 6 files you need
what runs where. You edit this 90% of the time
ONE Helm chart = the YAML template for every app
ArgoCD: one app per file in environments/
button: promote to prod, with approval
edits the image in an env file (CI uses it too)
you don't need them to explain the flow
see it: helm template orders-api charts/app
E. Practice path: 7 exercises (do -> see -> say)
every PR is tested on a
